lead: Guru Dutt was a film actor, born on 9 July 1925 in Bengaluru.
He died on 10 October 1964 in Mumbai at the age of 39.
He has 20 credited works on public record.
Below you will find a verified overview of Guru Dutt: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Guru Dutt — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Guru Dutt was born on 9 July 1925 in Bengaluru, and holds citizenship of British Raj, India and Dominion of India.
He is a sibling of Lalita Lajmi and Atma Ram.
His listed education includes Hare School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Guru Dutt — Career and Professional Work
paras: Guru Dutt works primarily as a film actor, film director, film producer, choreographer, screenwriter and film editor.
